reviews.subject: fix(material/chips): focus lingering on previous chip (#27559)
reviews.decision: The only hunk changes MatChipOption._handlePrimaryActionInteraction: a non-disabled primary-action interaction now calls focus before conditionally toggling selection. It addresses the modern option action focus unit, including selectable:false; no other source or test file changes. MatLegacyChip is an owned directive extending the local _MatChipMixinBase, with classic mat-chip/mat-basic-chip hosts and separate host click/focus handlers. It defines no _handlePrimaryActionInteraction. The whole589-file authored AST population has no current Material chips import/export/type/dynamic route, modern chip class/base or modern chip selector. The local base and each local mixin implementation are checked through the actual barrel. This is an individually verified source ownership exclusion, not a claim that the upstream Safari regression was executed or fixed in the legacy control.

reviews.subject: refactor(material/chips): remove TypeScript mixin usages
reviews.decision: All13 hunks cover removal of MatChipGridBase and _MatChipGridMixinBase, direct MatChipSet inheritance, introduction of the private upstream _ErrorStateTracker, changed constructor/NgControl visibility, error-state accessors/stateChanges/updateErrorState, and the matching public declaration changes. The API-guard file is a contract hunk and is retained as part of the whole review. The exported MatLegacyChipList retains the anonymous local mixinErrorState base and classic form-field/CVA contract. Its mixin resolves through its owned common-behaviors barrel to the owned function returning a class over its caller-supplied base. The original minimum public ErrorStateMatcher dependency remains; no private upstream _ErrorStateTracker is imported. No authored current MatChipGrid/MatChipSet dependency or subtype exists. Applying the current grid constructor/private-helper rewrite would create a different public implementation contract without serving this source owner; no such TypeScript or resource change is made.

reviews.subject: fix(material/chips): navigate between rows on up/down arrow (#29364)
reviews.decision: All13 hunks include the UP/DOWN imports, four new primary/trailing action row-navigation assertions, six retained fixture-formatting hunks, and the complete MatChipGrid keydown change. The new branch filters _chipActions by the active action _isPrimary and skip predicate, prevents default, and moves within that action column; TAB and fallback handling are also reviewed. The owned MatLegacyChipList manages MatLegacyChip focus units with FocusKeyManager configured for wrapping, vertical, horizontal and Home/End navigation. Its host _keydown delegates only chip-host targets to that manager. Neither owned class has the modern _chipActions/primary-action grid model, and no current chips class, selector, import or export is in the authored source graph. This upstream row/action navigation contract does not authorize changing the classic HTML/focus structure or styles. The separate existing keyboard/runtime gates remain required; source classification does not claim those tests were executed here.
